verdict.rationale: Porkbun's docs show broad API parity for core registrar tasks—domain registration/transfer/renewal, DNS CRUD, SSL retrieval, hosting/WordPress provisioning, marketplace/closeouts, webhooks, sandbox testing, and even an official MCP server exposing 96 tools (porkbun-docs-1,2,3,13,20,21,23,31). However, some UI-visible features (e.g., email hosting setup, account-level ID/age verification via Veriff) are not shown to have API equivalents, and no OpenAPI/machine-readable spec was found (porkbun-probe-2,3), leaving gaps in full UI-API parity claims. Missing for 10: API support for email hosting creation, account verification/KYC flows, and a formal OpenAPI schema confirming full endpoint coverage.
